attributes.name: ypy-list-focus
attributes.description: Moves the keyboard focus to the first item a `append` or `prepend` swap brought into this list, the same as the `focus` modifier of the swap (`ypy-swap="append key:id limit:50 focus"`, which wins over the attribute). The item gets `tabindex="-1"` when it cannot take focus by itself. The focus never leaves a field the user is typing in, and the page scrolls to the item only when the swap asks for it (`focusScroll:true`, or `config.defaultFocusScroll`). `false` turns it off.

values.name: false
values.description: Leaves the focus where it is.

events.name: ypy:list:pruned
events.description: Fires on the list after a swap with `limit:<n>` removed its oldest items to keep the limit. `removed` holds them, in document order; they are already out of the page.
